{{Top|leg}}
[[File:Borg_Construct_AJ6_Side_Schematic.png|thumb|right|250px|Side schematic of the Borg Construct Aj^6 showing the unit's Droid Interface Port.]]
A '''Droid Interface Port''' was a component installed on [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries']] [[AJ^6 cyborg construct/Legends|AJ^6 cyborg construct]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> It allowed the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] to communicate mentally with nearly any [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The port also allowed the cyborg to download data from the droid, as well as altering its programming.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
